source.title: Tracks in the Snow
source.description:
You done a good service, so now I help you. Last time I saw Van Amburgh, he had a menagerie of three animals: a great cat, a raptor, and a monstrous bug. He keep dem in cages, whip dem, drive dem to be mean. Cruelty and hunger be his training tools. Fought him in Feralas a while ago, not sure where he be now.

You should go meet up with Estelenn and see if she be needing ya. And be sure to give her my regards.
source.objective: Travel to the hills in Winterspring in northern Kalimdor, north of Everlook, to meet up with Estelenn and find out what else she needs.
source.completion: The remains of Estelenn's old campsite are cold. You may have to wait a while for her to come back. Better get comfortable.
